coordinate_unit: nominal CAD millimeters; STL contains no unit declaration
section_rule: Raw Trimesh.mesh_plane segments and source face IDs. Quantized endpoint graphs are descriptive only; preserve open, branched, duplicate and coplanar facts. No healing, fitting, caps or adaptive sections.
plane_rule: Computed triangle unit normals; orient globally from signed volume only for descriptive plane side tests. Cluster by rounded normal components/offsets, not a fitted replacement surface. Non-supporting is not proof of a particular convex partition.
figures: Three orthographic all-facet projections (including hidden edges; no occlusion filtering) plus fixed-section YZ panels. Magenta markers are projected frozen CAD bore witnesses, not newly sampled section geometry. MatplotlibAgg only.
prior_benchmarks: Contact3rounds and activequery2attempts remain closed; no new pool or old failure promotion.
scope: Read-only original-STL inspection. No proxy construction, cooking, Kit, simulation, material/registration changes or inferred fixed parts. No new dependencies/backends.
interpretation: Part feasibility is assessed from reported evidence after the single run, not asserted automatically.
